title: Candy shop
note: A generated image, reconstructed at about 3.3 times real size; the model saw it at 1.7 times real size; times are real time.

facts.what: A jelly cube (elastic, 10 kPa) dropped onto a heap of sprinkles (the model’s sand); at the moment the cube presses the sprinkles outward the prediction freezes and the camera swings (bullet time)
facts.extra: The marshmallow is photo pixels (it was not detected as an object) and the cube never reaches it. A known limit: the soft gummy bear sags at rest.
facts.sel: Seed 0; 6 of 8 seeds pass the selection rule, and seed 0 has no overlap and no entry into photo-only objects
